scope: Exact overlay publication and viewport cache identities; conservative upload retries and unknown-bounds caching
fixed_cases: Two distinct valid polygons with Java String hash 997868208 must not suppress a boundary refresh or share a viewport envelope.
Changed overlay name, population, area, kind, key or ordering must publish even with unchanged geometry.
A missing fill or boundary source must not mark the pair uploaded; false or throwing updates remain retryable.
Unknown or malformed envelopes remain included, and their null result is cached until the next overlay load.
Worker adoption of an equal snapshot must not resurrect publication after a concurrent style reset.

actual_renderer_comparison.cases: A colliding different geometry, a changed name, and changed population. Actual old/new postPlaceOverlay methods run with detached field setup and a counting Android Handler, without native map construction.

allocation_method.operation: Actual complete postPlaceOverlay unchanged-data fast path; old/new compiled classes, equal reflection overhead
allocation_method.fixture: 1000 immutable overlay records, 100 refreshes per sample, 30 warmup pairs, 11 alternating rounds; calling-thread medians
allocation_method.cpu_limit: Host CPU clock is coarse; zero means below timing resolution, not zero CPU cost. No CPU percentage claimed.

bounds.retention: One applied snapshot referencing the already-loaded immutable overlay objects; no geometry strings or JSON trees are copied. Equal refreshes adopt the current objects atomically so old equal payloads can be released. Bounds cache is cleared at the existing next-load boundary.
bounds.unknown_envelope_fixture: 20 repeated lookups: previous nullable getOrPut would parse20 times; new helper parses once, includes the polygon on every lookup, and parses again after clear.
bounds.eviction_and_capture: No persistent cache, cap, timer, GPS request, disk write or provider request is added.

limits: Synthetic local allocations are not Android peak RAM, physical battery life, storage, paid quota or fleet capacity measurements.
All geometry serialization, clipping, merging, containment, GPS, distance, road matching, fog rendering and server/gateway algorithms are unchanged.
